value_policy.rationale: The integrated baseline 5e84ca928dee is the control. Target an 8% to 12% geomean swapin latency reduction beyond calibrated noise with all 17 correctness gates passing.

selected_idea.bottleneck: When mTHP folios are swapped out to zswap, mm/memory.c:4816 unconditionally returns 0 in thp_swapin_suitable_orders() when zswap is active, forcing 16 separate order-0 page faults, 16 individual allocations, and 16 page table lock acquisitions for a single 64kB folio.
selected_idea.mechanism: Lift the blackout in mm/memory.c when an aligned contiguous swap cluster resides in zswap. Extend mm/zswap.c to verify contiguous residency for orders 2 and 4, decompress each subpage directly into high-order folio subpages (kmap_local_folio), and install all PTEs in do_swap_page() with a single set_ptes() call under one PTL hold, building on Milestone 1's allocator-first sync swapin engine.
selected_idea.expected_benefit: Slashing page fault entries and PTL hold cycles by 75% to 93.75% during mTHP swapin, delivering 5% to 10% latency reductions on swapin-zram-64k while preserving disk swapin performance and passing all 17 correctness gates.
selected_idea.simpler_alternative: Fall back to individual order-0 faults on every subpage as upstream currently does.
selected_idea.falsifier: Reject on partial decompression failure without clean order-0 fallback, slot leakage, race condition during concurrent faulting, failed correctness gate, or latency regression beyond calibrated noise.
required_evidence: Exact-tree independent source review including caller contracts
Fresh probe calibration under Protocol Revision 7 (or reference cache reuse)
selected_idea.no_upstream_reason: The relevant upstream implementation is already in the frozen baseline.
selected_idea.selection_reason: Combines demand-path allocator-first sync swapin with multi-slot zswap reassembly to eliminate redundant PTL hold overhead during mTHP swapin.
